description: This Java class implements an immutable version of the RetrieveAttributesLiveCommand, providing methods to create instances based on existing commands, set headers, and generate answer builders within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the RetrieveAttributesLiveCommand interface, providing functionality to create command instances with specified headers and generating answer builders.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandImpl from a generic Command object, casting to RetrieveAttributes.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified Ditto headers, preserving the original command's context.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Produces a new RetrieveAttributesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder for building responses.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including the class name and superclass string.
